title: Common velocity correct
description: Essential: The final common velocity for part (1) is correctly stated as \(\frac{2v_0}{3}\).

title: Momentum conservation applied
description: Important: Uses conservation of linear momentum for the system to relate initial and final velocities.

title: Relative velocity condition
description: Important: Correctly interprets and applies the condition that the plank's velocity is twice the slider's for part (2).

title: Work-energy or kinematics
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem or kinematics with friction to find the relative displacement in part (2).

title: Force balance for plank
description: Important: Recognizes that for uniform plank motion in parts (3) and (4), the external force balances the kinetic friction force \(\mu mg\).

title: Slider kinematics correct
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the slider to stop relative to the plank as \(\frac{v_0}{\mu g}\) for part (3).

title: Work calculation correct
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the work done by the external force as \(m v_0^2\) for part (4).

title: Sign error in friction work
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the work done by friction in the work-energy equation.

title: Incorrect system isolation
description: Pitfall: Fails to use conservation of momentum for the isolated system or incorrectly includes external forces.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Demonstrates unit analysis for final answers (velocity, distance, time, work).
